== June 2017 partial and full-image chronology ==
The shared [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|official PDF]], cover dated text as of June 1, 2017, prints this partial on page 8. Full sources are first located in repository records dated 8 July 2018, 31 March 2023, 18 June 2023, 29 July 2026. These records do not establish original first publication days. Descending moves preserve article/Talk histories and existing source assets. Bare current gameplay <code>4_122</code> follows image 5, matching the current constructor/configured face; no historical executable ID is invented. == Uncovered original fields beneath the June 2017 cutout ==
The source cover directs placing the lower cutout in a sleeve with the original physical card. Its replacement begins at the type band, below the original title, destiny and lore. The original [[:File:Dagobah-D-flagship-decipher-archive.gif]] supplies the still-uncovered destiny 3 and literal lore; later full PC faces are not the source of these inherited values. Existing lower-slip text, images, numbering, links and executable IDs are retained. Cover/source: [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]], PDF page 8.
